quote.text:
All that is gold does not glitter,
Not all those who wander are lost.
intro_p1: Shadows as long as ages fall upon Middle-earth. The Free Peoples raise their standards, while from the north and from the south the footsteps of those who serve the Shadow are heard once more.
intro_p2_pre: The story of 2026 will unfold over the coming weeks. Follow the
intro_p2_post: — the first rumours will reach you before the armies march to battle.

alert.body_pre: Before we raise the banners, look through the
alert.body_post: . The narrative frame is enough to set the mood — to play, you'll need a costume, registration and courage.

story_image.alt: Pelargir on the Anduin before the siege: the Gondorian city and its harbour, the camps of the Dark Lord’s forces on the near bank, burning countryside and a corsair ship under construction.
story_image.caption: Pelargir and the Anduin on the eve of the siege. Enemy camps and waggons to the left, a corsair shipyard in the right foreground.
